# MathDB claim update

Append this as a comment or update only the agent-owned handoff block. Preserve
claimant replies, team decisions, old versions and public-review history.

- Existing claim: <URL>
- Public handoff ID, event/review ID and revision: <IDs>
- Rules version: mathdb
- JSP, MathDB problem and stable actual claimant: <IDs and public profile>
- Update time (UTC): <timestamp>
- Update type: <new qualifying category / evidence supplement / material change / conclusion withdrawal / team-status synchronization>
- Affected category and material version: <details>
- Previous conclusion/version: <record>
- Current trusted conclusion/version and evidence: <record>
- JSP/MathDB correspondence and page-statement consistency: <current confirmed formulation; unresolved mapping or statement correction puts affected handoffs on hold>
- Date/priority or committee checks for a new category: <passed evidence; otherwise do not add a formal claim category>
- Other affected claims/categories: <links; include Solution payment if complete Lean evidence is lost>
- Consequence: <continue review / awaiting evidence / affected category on hold / team decision>
- Public review: <actual team-published start/end and decision; do not infer or restart automatically>
- Required contributor action and next responsible party: <specific action or none>
- Notification: <pending / accepted by sender at UTC time / failed; team copied>

Only team-confirmed announcement/payment outcomes may be synchronized. A passed
technical review, issue closure or elapsed notice period is not payment evidence.
